claim_to_review: NHANES 2003-2006 PAM is independent from NHANES 2011-2014 wrist/MIMS by participant, cycle, device placement, and source metric.
interpretation_limit: Do not describe this as an independent clinical cancer-survivorship cohort.

claim_to_review: Hip ActiGraph counts/minute and wrist MIMS can be grouped only under broad movement-volume constructs; numeric equivalence is blocked.
interpretation_limit: No MIMS-to-counts conversion, cut-point transfer, MVPA, sedentary, or clinical activity-status claim.

claim_to_review: PAXSTEP is a source-specific hip-worn step metric and cannot be inferred from wrist MIMS.
PhysioNet ActiLife steps are a real same-cohort derived metric source, not an independent external validation dataset.
interpretation_limit: Correlation can be descriptive only and does not validate conversion or intensity classification.

claim_to_review: Valid-day rules are completeness/sensitivity rules only, not physical activity intensity classifications.
interpretation_limit: Do not call eligible participants active/inactive or classify MVPA/sedentary status from these rules.

claim_to_review: Independent PAM daily summaries are represented as source-specific validation summaries, not identity-linked participants.
interpretation_limit: Do not infer person-level linkage between NHANES 2003-2006 and 2011-2014 cohorts.
